resources.string: Take turns placing stones on the crossings. Surround empty points, and capture stones by taking away all their free points. When both players pass, stones plus surrounded points are counted: the higher score wins.
Small and quick. The best way to start.
Medium size: more room for plans.
The full classic board. Pinch to zoom in.
Tap the same crossing again to place your stone
The computer passed. Keep playing, or pass too to count the points.
Not yet: you cannot take back the ko right away. Play somewhere else first.
Not there: your stone would have no free points left.
Crossed-out stones count as captured. Tap a group to change it, then tap Count.
The computer’s count includes %1$s for playing second.
Hint: there is nothing more to gain. You can pass.
